# netcup_server_rescue_system (Ephemeral Resource)

The status of the rescue system of a netcup server with its password (SCP REST API). It needs Terraform 1.10 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_server_rescue_system" "repair" {
  server_id = 12345
}

ephemeral "netcup_server_rescue_system" "repair" {
  server_id  = netcup_server_rescue_system.repair.server_id
  depends_on = [netcup_server_rescue_system.repair]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the rescue system is active.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the rescue system, null while it is inactive.
